bug_semantics: An authenticated backend user with cms.manage_assets could put an =include or =require directive containing ../ traversal in a theme JavaScript asset. JavascriptImporter resolved the target with realpath() and read it with File::get() without checking either its extension or whether the resolved path remained below an approved root. System\Classes\CombineAssets then placed the bytes in a stable combine/{file} response that required no authentication, exposing arbitrary PHP-readable files such as .env to unauthenticated visitors.
flaw_origin: The root-cause lines originated in the Winter Storm dependency's October Rain JavascriptImporter, then were wired into the Winter core asset-combiner/public-output path from Winter core's initial code import.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object identifies author Sam Georges (@daftspunk) and committer Sam Georges (@daftspunk), has the sole message "Add Assetic filters (Combiner)", an empty body, and no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, assistant, bot, or other AI trailer/marker.
evidence: First-party advisory: https://github.com/wintercms/winter/security/advisories/GHSA-2223-f22x-24cq states affected <1.2.13 and patched v1.2.13; it documents the authenticated cms.manage_assets write, traversal such as =include ../../../.env, unauthenticated combine/{file} disclosure, and the two-part Winter core/Storm repair.

Smallest BIC: https://github.com/wintercms/storm/commit/0c6d68a554177de909247c255560d77b86748670 adds src/October/Rain/Combiner/Filter/JavaScript/Importer.php from /dev/null. Added lines 113-130 append .js only when no extension is supplied, resolve realpath($this->scriptPath . '/' . $script), check only existence, then call File::get($scriptPath); there is no extension allowlist or root-containment gate. The same commit's embedded first-party commit data gives the full direct parent 0bf66830b64e5e99384bf25c5a78d0f2a6e5388a and oldTreeEntry:null, proving the vulnerable file/lines absent in the direct parent.

History was followed across renames rather than treating them as introducers: 8f17f75bdbe79b0ad50f22a554ade79cf0b05c95 moved the importer from Combiner to Support, 0fba71b3a3fc29191f9bffcd32e9c720199c90b3 was a PSR-4 tree move, 974110bb66edf7c168e04c98e6c2b3ddc4705eb9 was a case/path-only rename, 89e8c570252121ab9b49c0029307667474ac2ad0 moved it under Parse/Assetic, and later namespace migrations retained the vulnerable realpath/read behavior. Therefore none of those moves is the BIC.

Winter integration lifecycle: local git -S history for registerFilter('js' in modules/system/classes/CombineAssets.php follows the file back to 71a5dd67ab9e0d0da7caabd3fb5aaa3d86bb45e5. That commit added modules/cms/classes/CombineAssets.php, registered October\Rain\Support\Filters\JavascriptImporter, created public combined responses, and has direct parent d412ea685560a3ce7028346d26fd9a6559eb0827. git grep JavascriptImporter at that parent returned no match (exit 1), and the parent tree had no CombineAssets path. The later 7026baf4b7c587ae27dbbfae231a714162b74c9b Assetic-v3 change merely changed namespaces while preserving registration: https://github.com/wintercms/winter/commit/7026baf4b7c587ae27dbbfae231a714162b74c9b.

Version boundary proof from the assigned clone: git tag --sort=version:refname begins at v1.0.319, and git tag --contains 71a5dd67ab9e0d0da7caabd3fb5aaa3d86bb45e5 begins at v1.0.319, so the vulnerable Winter integration predates its tagged affected releases. git merge-base --is-ancestor showed the integration is in v1.2.12 (exit 0), e09c8d3526f3583cb6c3476a021b885088ecd4bd is absent from v1.2.12 (exit 1), and that fix is present in v1.2.13 (exit 0), matching the advisory's <1.2.13 / v1.2.13 boundary.

Core fix: https://github.com/wintercms/winter/commit/e09c8d3526f3583cb6c3476a021b885088ecd4bd configures themes_path(), plugins_path(), and base_path('modules') as allowed roots for JavascriptImporter/LESS/CSS and adds regression coverage. Direct root-cause fix: https://github.com/wintercms/storm/commit/fd673f4f32140c97c68b1ed705764b819747fbdf adds the .js-only rule and PathResolver::withinAny() containment enforcement in JavascriptImporter. The advisory explicitly requires both and identifies both as v1.2.13 fixes.

BIC-only attribution proof: https://github.com/wintercms/storm/commit/0c6d68a554177de909247c255560d77b86748670 embedded commit data reports authoredDate/committedDate 2013-12-28T09:22:02+11:00, author and committer Sam Georges (@daftspunk), bodyMessageHtml empty, and no trailers or AI marker. No fix, move, or later commit object was used for the attribution verdict.
reasoning: The vulnerable primitive is the importer's acceptance of a user-controlled directive path followed by unconstrained realpath() and File::get(); Winter core supplies the reachable/public attack path by applying that filter to backend-editable theme JavaScript and serving the combined result without authentication. History reconstruction shows that the root-cause code was first written—not merely moved—in Storm commit 0c6d68a554177de909247c255560d77b86748670. Its direct parent lacks the new importer file, while every later candidate is a rename, namespace migration, or integration-preserving refactor. Winter's core integration commit 71a5dd67ab9e0d0da7caabd3fb5aaa3d86bb45e5 predates all tagged Winter releases in the clone and is present in v1.2.12. The coordinated v1.2.13 repair changes the vulnerable importer directly in fd673f4f32140c97c68b1ed705764b819747fbdf and supplies approved roots from core in e09c8d3526f3583cb6c3476a021b885088ecd4bd; tag ancestry confirms the core fix is absent from v1.2.12 and present in v1.2.13. Finally, the exact BIC commit object is a 2013 human-authored/committed object with an empty body and no AI marker, so under BIC-only attribution this is NOT_AI.
